entries.title: Bespoke flow generation: a design dossier
entries.current_reading: Design dossier toward genuine novel-flow generation. Built from a grounded multi-agent audit plus an adversarial review that returned OVERCLAIMS; the six corrections are folded in. Spine: the validity-vs-efficacy distinction (validity is checkable offline and inherited free by instantiation; efficacy must be earned by running and scoring); the floor-as-verifier reframe (a generator proposes a topology from registered blocks, the deterministic assemble/compile/catalog gates dispose, so a model in the proposer seat is safe for VALIDITY on static proposals only, structural not semantic); the eight spike walls, dissolved only for the registered 9-block linear band; the real frontier is catalog coverage (16 of 29 blocks unplaceable, composeFlow throws on sub-run/fanout). Lays a Rung 0/1/2 ladder, a Rung 1 first slice (a single-leaf sub-run orchestration that clears the real floor offline), an efficacy-certification plan, and a zero-cost catalog-coverage probe. SUPERSEDED IN PART by what was since walked: the eight walls have been dissolved across the non-linear shapes (loop/sub-run/fanout all run live, PRs #123-133) and the two composer-intelligence layers this dossier reserved — producibility-aware selection and family reachability — both SHIPPED as frontier phases A-D (PRs #134-138), with a second family (build) now composing and running live and a topology efficacy-flat finding. See non-linear-composition-frontier.md for the as-walked record. This dossier remains the design rationale and the propose-half plan (a model that PROPOSES topologies, not just linearizes a hand-authored role-set) is still un-built. No src change; the genuine-generation spike stays untracked.

entries.title: The non-linear composition frontier
entries.current_reading: Empirical companion to the bespoke-generation dossier: the non-linear frontier as actually walked, now well past the original three-tier sweep. The whole validity ladder is built and on main: the bounded inspect/fix/verify LOOP (PR #123), SUB-RUN across a flow boundary (#124), static FANOUT joined by aggregate-survivors (#125/#126), a plain-LINEAR triage close (#130), and an offline RUNNABILITY detector that catches un-runnable composed flows the structural floor was blind to (#131). The composed-vs-reference efficacy arm then landed COMPOSITION-VIABLE (#132), and the fanout terminal-close fix (PR #133, f42c2e4e) made the composed FANOUT shape run LIVE end-to-end. The 2026-06-20 synthesis named the remaining composer-intelligence frontier as TWO LAYERS — producibility-aware SELECTION and family REACHABILITY — and BOTH HAVE SINCE SHIPPED (frontier phases A-D, all merged to main): Phase A (PR #134) turned the runnability gate from detect-only into repair-then-wall via a family-coherence tiebreak in selectActual; Phase C (PR #135) made the goal opener's clarified-task producible (the goal family's own clarify relay) plus an always-on intermediate compose-reads wiring pass, closing the last shape that wasn't full-flow runnable; Phase B-offline (PR #136) made the build family reachable (checkpointWritesReport + donor report_template) so build composes end-to-end. Phase B-live (PR #137) then ran a composed BUILD flow vs the hand-authored reference — 4/4 objective-fixed, 0 false-fixed, strictly cheaper every task — an EXISTENCE PROOF that a second family composes and runs live, not just fix. Phase D (PR #138) ran the same composed fix arc at three topologies (lean 5-block / full 6-block / loop 6-block+retry) and found flow topology EFFICACY-FLAT and COST-REAL: extra blocks bought cost (lean ~32% cheaper, ~31% faster), not capability; the recovery loop never fired; step-level judgement, not graph shape, is the scarce ingredient. Findings in evals/dynamic-vs-reference/{composed-build-arm-finding,composed-shape-sensitivity-finding}.md. RESEARCH_THEN_BUILD still walls honestly (no runnable family). Remaining open: the proof-richness gap (generic flow.result@v1 closes leaner than a family's full proof bundle — disclosed, not laundered), a discriminating (failure-inducing) task set so the loop's recovery branch can fire, and the low-value Tier-2 forward branch / self-loop. Default-OFF; built-ins byte-identical throughout.

entries.title: Circuit: the alternative to chat
entries.current_reading: Strategy deliverable (2026-06-29 multi-agent exploration plus an editorial and honesty pass against docs/positioning.md). Thesis: Circuit moves the human from inside the loop (orchestrator, memory, router, verifier) to on the loop (author the process once, review the evidence); the defensible claim is where chat-work graduates when it must be repeated, scheduled, chained, or trusted by someone who was not watching, and the one genuinely new thing is an evidence-provenance gate the worker cannot talk past. Three keystone bets (readable run, honest stop, promote-a-run) plus open forks. Honest limits are load-bearing: do not say 'alternative to chat' unqualified, do not say 'it can't fake done', do not promise 'turn your past chats into flows'. Messaging and product context, not shipped behavior; no copy ships without operator sign-off.

entries.title: Improve flow: Circuit's outer loop
entries.current_reading: Product and flow proposal for an `Improve` flow: a controlled outer loop that studies prior Circuit runs, ranks repeated or high-value signals, and proposes exactly one bounded change to a flow, check, Skill Hook, Power policy, eval, or doc. V1 is proposal-only: frame one target flow/window/proposal kind, read run folders/traces/reports/operator summaries/history index/Git/test output/optional CI metadata, emit `improve.signals@v1` plus `improve.proposal@v1`, then stop at a Checkpoint before any write. It is not an autonomous daemon, not memory authority, not the until-loop, and not a generic make-Circuit-better prompt. Constraints: history remains hint-only; traces/reports/files/commits/checks/operator-declared decisions are authoritative; runtime stays flow-neutral; writes are explicit; cost is bounded. First useful slice needs no new engine primitive. Later slices can add branch mode, flow/check edits, Skill Hook suggestions, Power bounds, batch ranking, and scheduled notification. Includes a starter `/goal` for implementing the proposal-only flow. Nothing built.

entries.title: Intra-run decision carry-forward
entries.current_reading: Design note (return-to-later) for the lead nugget from the no-mistakes study: carry the operator's settled checkpoint decision forward into the next relay's prompt so a downstream agent does not re-litigate, re-derive, or silently reverse a call the human already made inside the same run. Grounded in real seams as of 2026-06-26: the producer already records the decision (checkpoint-resume.ts re-enters graph-runner with resumeCheckpoint {stepId, attempt, selection}; checkpoint.ts reads it for routing only; the decision is already in the trace via the human-decision block), and the consumer already has a structured additive relay-prompt guidance system (relay-support.ts: operator skills, house-style slots, tool scope, delivered-context, memory-pull). The gap is the wire between them: no relay section renders the settled decision. Proposed mechanism: a trace-derived in-memory decision ledger rendered as one new opt-in additive 'settled-by-operator' section, wired exactly like context delivery (enableContextDelivery / contextDeliveryActive: a run-wide signal threaded graph-runner -> RunContext -> RunValue -> relay prompt, default off, default byte-identical, added explicitly to the RunValue projection so it is not silently dropped). NOT pull-suppression.ts (that is the measured-harm memory channel; this is a parallel operator-decision channel and must not share its code). Scope: intra-run only (smallest safe first rung of the unbuilt cross-run compounding loop), no findings-checklist UI, validity-first with a separate later live efficacy arm. Nothing built; verify every cited symbol before use.

entries.title: Model roster and intensity: two operator knobs over a promoted roster
entries.current_reading: Concept-first design note on collapsing model, effort, and connector selection into two operator knobs: a global roster (archetype to connector plus a baseline rung, with per-flow and per-step overrides) and one intensity dial that offsets every archetype along per-connector (model, effort) ladders. Reframes the shipped power dial as a hard-coded roster to promote into editable config. Its recommended first slice has since SHIPPED TO MAIN: the resolve-without-spawn readout landed as circuit preview (src/cli/preview.ts, src/cli/flow-selection-preview.ts), the codex default model now resolves from the live models cache (src/connectors/codex-default-model.ts), and per-step connector pinning ships as a working flow (src/flows/cross-tool-build/). The roster-as-editable-config and dial-as-scalar remain unbuilt.

entries.title: Flow ideas: stack-ranked backlog
entries.current_reading: The one ranked list of candidate post-v1 flows, scored on impact and virality. Seeded 2026-07-02 from the software-factory pattern analysis (Decompose, Merge Gate, Dispatch are net-new candidates) plus the flow ideas already parked in this directory (Promote, Steer, Improve, Spec, Align). Also records which parts of the factory pattern are already shipped Circuit behavior or deliberately rejected, and the settled 2026-07-02 stance that outward comms (Slack, tracker writes) are boundary deliveries from typed artifacts in the host session, never step equipment inside a relay. Prioritization context only; the v1 launch freeze applies and nothing in it is being built.
